+search.semantic_delta: Validated itemList parsing, deterministic title filtering, bounded cursor pagination, de-duplication and completeness ledger; replaces the deprecated +minutes-search discovery route.

+minutes-search.semantic_delta: Hidden compatibility leaf preserving the historical Schema identity and argv while routing new discovery to +search.

+download.semantic_delta: Resolves real audio/video URLs, validates response shape and performs batch safe atomic local downloads with an explicit failure ledger.

+upload.semantic_delta: Owns local file validation, create-PUT-complete polling, pre-complete transfer cancellation compensation, unknown-completion recovery and final task read-back verification.

+update.semantic_delta: Reads the current title, previews the diff, avoids no-op writes and verifies the final title by read-back.

+apply-permission.semantic_delta: Maps view/download/edit intent to policy 4/3/2 and validates the permission-request response.

+summary.semantic_delta: Reads current summary, supports literal/file/stdin, preserves Markdown images, previews the change and verifies full read-back.

+speaker-replace.semantic_delta: Fully paginates the transcript to preflight source speaker presence and verifies the nickname replacement after writing.

+record-wrap-up.semantic_delta: Stops recording once, then boundedly waits for selected validated artifacts and preserves taskUuid recovery on partial completion.

+upload-and-analyze.semantic_delta: Completes local upload with compensation, waits for validated artifacts, and optionally orchestrates mind map and speaker insights without re-upload recovery hazards.

+mindmap.semantic_delta: Creates the asynchronous mind-graph task exactly once and polls the explicit 0/1/2 taskStatus to success, failure or timeout.

+speaker-insights.semantic_delta: Requires a real async taskId, boundedly polls speaker summaries and returns task recovery handles when content is not ready.

+prepare-asr.semantic_delta: Reads the real personal hot-word set, computes deterministic add/delete differences, defaults to additive changes and verifies final state.

+export-pack.semantic_delta: Validates selected artifacts, safely publishes a no-clobber local directory and emits a manifest without signed URLs or credentials.

+share.semantic_delta: Grants semantic view/download/edit permissions per stable member UID with stop/continue partial-write ledgers and explicit acknowledgements.

+unshare.semantic_delta: Removes permission per stable member UID with stop/continue partial-write ledgers and explicit acknowledgements.

+list-mine.semantic_delta: Stable projection of current-user Minutes with strict itemList response validation.

+list-shared.semantic_delta: Stable projection of shared Minutes with strict itemList response validation.

+list-all.semantic_delta: Stable projection of all accessible Minutes with strict itemList response validation.

+record-start.semantic_delta: Friendly recording-create facade with explicit confirmation and stable session parameter.

+record-pause.semantic_delta: Friendly recording-pause facade with explicit task UUID validation and confirmation.

+record-resume.semantic_delta: Friendly recording-resume facade with explicit task UUID validation and confirmation.

+record-stop.semantic_delta: Friendly recording-stop facade with explicit task UUID validation and confirmation.

+latest.semantic_delta: Validates the real itemList response and chooses latest only from an explicit comparable timestamp before reading details; +latest-minutes remains a compatibility alias.

+transcript.semantic_delta: Resolves an explicit or latest task, follows every transcript cursor, de-duplicates paragraphs and publishes completeness.

+action-items.semantic_delta: Resolves the latest task through strict itemList parsing and retrieves extracted Minutes actions without pretending to write Todo objects.

+detail.semantic_delta: Fans out selected artifacts, fully paginates transcript data, validates artifact-specific shapes and returns non-zero on partial reads.

+replace-batch.semantic_delta: Validates multi-rule input, supports JSON/file/stdin and reports partial writes with stop/continue policy and non-zero failure.
